userRule: Non-budgeted history only upon explicit forecast request; budget-only reporting only selected-budget activity.
scopeRequirements: Canonical current budget and account authorization, derived by trusted readers.
Optional non-budgeted rows must come from currently linked accounts.
Other-budget and unresolved assignment rows never become extra history.
Allocation portions are retained; no implicit transaction reassignment.
Inputs completeness is not a proof of complete query/data coverage.
reportIsolation: Existing report filters reject includeNonBudgetedHistory and filter monetary contribution slices to selected budget IDs.
forecastWindowDecision: Open-ended budgets default to the next 12 calendar months. Dated budgets default to their budget dates. Both windows are adjustable.
